notes.title: Nephilim Uprising Major Monday October 21st – Revamped Gameplay & New Features!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Exciting news for all Nephilim Uprising players—our latest major update is just around the corner! 
Here’s what you can expect:
[/b][/h1]

[b]Updated Visual Graphics:[/b] Experience the game in an all-new light with enhanced visuals.

[b]Updated Background Music:[/b] Dive deeper into the action with newly composed background music to set the tone.

[b]Mob and Player Balance:[/b] We’ve updated health and damage values for mobs and players, creating a better-balanced experience.

[b]New Weapons & Updated Damage:[/b] Unlock powerful new weapons, each with rebalanced damage to match the game’s new difficulty levels.

[b]Skill and Leveling Systems: [/b]A revamped leveling system introduces a skill and skill point system, giving you more control over your character’s progression.

[b]Improved Inventory System:[/b] We’ve added new features, including a merchant, selling options, and overall inventory improvements.

[b]Level Quality & Difficulty Adjustments:[/b] Levels have been improved for a smoother experience, with difficulty adjustments to keep you on your toes.

[b]Currency System:[/b] Collect and use a new in-game currency to make purchases and upgrades.

[b]Boss Level Separation:[/b] Boss battles are now on dedicated levels, separated from regular gameplay for a more focused challenge.

We're excited to bring these changes to you, and keep an eye on this space for more details and prepare to jump back into Nephilim Uprising! ⚔️"

[h3][b]And that’s not all! We’ll be hosting a live stream event shortly after the update drops, showcasing all the new features and answering your burning questions! Stay tuned for the stream date![/b][/h3]
